title: Questionnaire sur l'atteinte et le risque liés à l'asthme (AIRQ)
formula:
The AIRQ Score is calculated by the addition of the selected points:

| Question | Points | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| In the past 2 weeks , has coughing, wheezing, shortness of breath, or chest tightness… | | |
| Bothered you during the day on more than 4 days ? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Woke you up from sleep more than 1 time ? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Limited the activities you want to do every day ? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Caused you to use your rescue inhaler or nebulizer every day ? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| In the past 2 weeks … | | |
| Did you have to limit your social activities (such as visiting with friends/relatives or playing with pets/children) because of your asthma? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Did coughing, wheezing, shortness of breath, or chest tightness limit your ability to exercise? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Did you feel that it was difficult to control your asthma? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| In the past 12 months , has coughing, wheezing, shortness of breath, or chest tightness… | | |
| Caused you to take steroid pills or shots, such as prednisone or methylprednisolone? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Caused you to go to the emergency room or have unplanned visits to a health care provider? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Caused you to stay in the hospital overnight? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |

how_to_use.when:
- Ne pas utiliser pour poser le diagnostic d’asthme.
- À utiliser comme outil d’aide à l’évaluation du contrôle de l’asthme chez les patients.

next_steps.advice: Utilisez-vous l’Asthma Impairment and Risk Questionnaire (AIRQ) et souhaitez-vous mettre à contribution votre expertise ? [Rejoignez](https://www.mdcalc.com/join-us) notre équipe de contributeurs !

more_info:
Interpretation:

| AIRQ Score | Asthma Severity |
| --- | --- |
| 0-1 | Well-controlled |
| 2-4 | Not well-controlled |
| 5-10 | Very poorly controlled |
